CREATE TABLE "public"."promo" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "minimumOrderValue" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "percentage" float8 NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "promo_count_min_857bca31" CHECK (count >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "promo_minimum_order_value_847d9933" CHECK ("minimumOrderValue" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "promo_percentage_range_5e052d98" CHECK (percentage >= 1 AND percentage <= 100)
)
